Six Hundred Sixty-Six
SIX HUN-dred SIK-stee-SIX
n.
From the Greek numeral letters chi-xi-sigma (χξς) in Revelation 13:18, where John commands that the one who has wisdom “calculate the number of the beast.” The number is that of a man — arithmos anthrŏpou — and has been variously interpreted as gematria for Nero Caesar, a Solomonic reference (1 Kgs 10:14), or the triple-six symbolism of human fallenness one short of divine seven.

Biblical Definition

The number six hundred sixty-six appears three times in Scripture. Its most luminous occurrence is Revelation 13:18, where it is named “the number of the beast” — a number identified as “that of a man,” demanding wisdom for its calculation. In the immediate narrative, it marks those who bear the beast’s name or its number and thereby receive the right to buy and sell (Rev 13:17). Six in Scripture is the number of man and his labor (man was made on the sixth day; the six-day week ends in the Sabbath rest God gives). Triple six — 6-6-6 — is thus a counterfeit trinity: man at his maximum self-assertion, the creature claiming the divine prerogatives of the seventh without entering God’s rest. The second occurrence is strikingly different: 1 Kings 10:14 records that the weight of gold brought to Solomon annually was six hundred sixty-six talents. The Solomonic association is not incidental: Solomon’s wisdom and wealth were genuine gifts of God that he then traded for compromise with foreign wives, foreign gods, and oppressive taxation. His golden empire, numbered at 666, became the type of the worldly kingdom that accumulates glory on its own terms and in its own name. The third occurrence is Ezra 2:13, where 666 is the number of Adonikam’s descendants among those returning from exile — a minor administrative notation. The beast’s number stands as the permanent mark of every totalizing, godless power that demands worship and controls commerce.

Webster 1828 Definition

Six hundred sixty-six: the number of the beast in Revelation 13:18; the symbol of the creature at full self-assertion, one perpetual step short of divine rest — and the annual weight of Solomon’s gold, a type of worldly glory accumulated without God.

SIX HUNDRED SIXTY-SIX, n. (Rev 13:18) The number assigned to the beast from the sea — a number requiring wisdom to calculate, identified as “the number of a man.” In the Reformed and historicist traditions it has been read as gematria for specific rulers (Nero, Domitian) or as the symbolic representation of maximal human self-exaltation: triple-six, the number of man tripled but never reaching God’s seven.

The same figure appears in 1 Kings 10:14 as Solomon’s annual tribute of gold, linking it to the seductive glory of earthly empire. The pattern recurs: what begins as God’s gift (Solomon’s wisdom) becomes, when pursued apart from God’s covenant, the 666-stamped currency of the worldly system.

Key Scripture

Revelation 13:18 — "Here is wisdom: let the one who has understanding calculate the number of the beast — for the number is that of a man, and his number is six hundred and sixty-six."

1 Kings 10:14 — "The weight of gold that came to Solomon yearly was six hundred and sixty-six talents of gold,"

1 Kings 19:18 — "Yet I will leave 7,000 in Israel — all the knees that have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth that has not kissed him."

Romans 11:4 — "But what is the divine response to him? “I have kept for Myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”"

Modern Corruption

Popular culture treats 666 as a horror-film brand and a source of superstitious dread, while charismatic prophecy culture obsessively maps it onto biometric technology, microchips, and payment systems in ways that replace the text’s summons to wisdom with apocalyptic speculation.

expand to see more

The entertainment industry has reduced 666 to a horror icon — a Halloween scare, a shock symbol, a tattoo of edginess. The trivialization is a real corruption: Revelation calls for wisdom, not a shudder. The number identifies a spiritual principle — the creature in maximal opposition to God — that is both historically embodied (in Rome, in every totalitarian state) and eschatologically complete in the final beast. Detaching it from that theological content leaves only superstition.

Prophetic sub-culture has generated an industry of speculation mapping 666 onto Social Security numbers, credit card systems, QR codes, vaccine passports, and implanted chips. Revelation 13 does not say the mark is a microchip; it says the mark involves allegiance to the beast’s authority and identity. Every generation has its beast-empire demanding total commercial and social loyalty. Wisdom consists not in identifying the chip but in refusing the allegiance.

Greek & Hebrew Roots

The Greek numeral letters chi-xi-sigma encode the number as a cipher, demanding the reader’s wise interpretation; the Solomonic parallel in 1 Kings embeds it in the larger biblical theology of worldly glory as a covenant hazard.

expand to see more

Greek numeral letters chi (600), xi (60), sigma (6) — the written form in the earliest Revelation manuscripts.

Hebrew gematria — the practice of summing the numerical values of letters; Neron Caesar in Hebrew letters sums to 666.

Six (hex/shesh) — the number of man; triple-six is humanity at its self-made maximum.

Solomon’s 666 talents (1 Kgs 10:14) — the Solomonic type of godless golden empire, gift corrupted into idol.

Latin bestiae numerus — “number of the beast,” as rendered in the Vulgate of Rev 13:18.

Usage

"John’s call for wisdom in calculating 666 is not an invitation to numerological speculation but a summons to discern the spirit of the age: which empire, which system, which loyalty-demand bears the mark of creaturely self-deification?"

"Solomon’s 666 talents of annual gold reads as a warning embedded in the historical record: divine gifts, when pursued beyond covenant limits, become the very currency of the system God opposes."

"Every saint who refused to receive the mark of the beast refused not a barcode but a total allegiance — the choice Scripture sets before every generation between the seal of God and the mark of the creature-empire."
